cuts.ofreeRecent: an open gantry stairway up the side of a docked ship — standing with one foot up on a step; A quiet floating relaxation capsule above a luminous nocturnal ocean — She reaches for a drifting sleep mask after the capsule gravity gently lowers; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; A transparent orbital sightseeing elevator moving above a blue planet in late morning — She watches a weightless paper souvenir spiral beside the window and gently blows it toward the glass; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; her crew cabin aboard a starship — lying on her left side; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — perched on a ledge or edge; an alchemist's potion workshop — standing close to a high shelf or line; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; an art or pottery studio of easels — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her
